_comment: Committed federation seed list. The crawler walks these on startup/interval so ecosystem nodes are discovered automatically — no hand-editing of node lists anywhere. Each seed's `public_key` is operator-vouched: when a seed advertises exactly this Ed25519 key, the crawler trusts and indexes it on FIRST contact (instead of waiting for manual approval). A key mismatch falls back to the safe untrusted-first-contact path. Override the whole list with AIMARKET_SEED_LIST and pins with AIMARKET_SEED_PUBKEYS, or point AIMARKET_SEEDS_FILE elsewhere.

seeds.name: Oracle Family (AIMarket v2)
seeds.note: Federated oracle-family endpoint aggregating all 17 oracles (Platon chaos-VRF/beacon, Chronos Wesolowski VDF, Lattice low-discrepancy, Murmuration robust consensus, Lumen EigenTrust/PageRank, Colony TSP, Turing blue-noise, Percola percolation, Fermat routing, Ablation cascade-risk, Landauer thermodynamic audit, Sortes ECVRF verifiable randomness, Gauss Gaussian-process regression, Aestus RSW time-lock puzzles, Betti persistent homology, Kantor optimal transport, Fourier graph-spectral analysis) behind one signed manifest. The 'oracle'/'randomness-beacon' categories let the hub route invokes to the peer's mcp_endpoint. Verified live 2026-06-13.
